title.en: Dedicated groomers praised by regular clients

text.en: Most dog owners praise individual groomers at the Sherry Lane salon, particularly Austin and Brittany, for their sincere care and strong rapport with clients. While one reviewer felt service standards had declined and chose not to return, regular visitors commend the staff for their kindness and consistency.

title.en: Patient handling for senior and anxious dogs

text.en: Reviewers frequently highlight how well the team handles nervous poodles, Boston terriers, and senior dogs. Owners appreciate that the groomers pay attention to each dog mood and quirks, adapting the session so pets return home calm, happy, and comfortable.

title.en: Detailed coat styling and mat removal

text.en: Clients report consistent grooming results across visits, noting strong attention to detail on breed cuts and full grooms. Pet parents specifically praise the groomers for carefully detangling and fixing badly matted coats on breeds such as Bichons and poodles.

q.en: Does Kibble Pet Grooming at Preston Center handle anxious or senior dogs?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers mention bringing senior dogs and nervous pups, noting that the groomers adapt to their behaviour to keep them comfortable.

q.en: Can the groomers treat matted dog coats?

a.en: Yes, clients note that the groomers effectively handle and tidy up heavily matted coats during full grooming sessions.

q.en: What grooming products and booking options are offered?

a.en: The salon uses natural conditioning ingredients, offers coat styling, de-shedding, and nail trims, and supports online booking.
